Parse a TOML document — toml_parse
text: Reads TOML document ordinary R values: table becomes named list keys document order, array vector list, value R type . Types come document's syntax: "2024-01-01" stays string 2024-01-01 becomes Date. whole document checked, toml_validate(), R value built.

title: Parse a TOML document — toml_parse
code: toml_parse(   x,   version = c("1.1.0", "1.0.0"),   simplify = c("preserve", "none"),   data_frame = FALSE,   big_integers = c("bigint", "double", "error"),   datetimes = c("convert", "keep"),   local_time = c("character", "difftime"),   max_size = 64 * 1024^2,   max_depth = 128L,   max_items = 1e+06,   max_string = 2^31 - 1 )

title: Parse a TOML document — toml_parse
text: x TOML document: single string, raw vector UTF-8 bytes. version TOML version read: "1.1.0" (default) "1.0.0", refuses forms 1.1.0 added (\e \xHH escapes, times without seconds, newlines trailing comma inline tables). simplify "preserve" (default) turns arrays whose elements share type vectors; "none" makes every array list. data_frame TRUE, array whose elements tables becomes data frame: one row per table, columns first-seen key order, missing keys NA. Columns whose values share type lists. getOption("zutoml.max_df_cells", 1e7) cells raises zutoml_limit_error, since rows share keys make frame quadratic size. big_integers integers beyond 2^53, double hold exactly: "bigint" (default) returns toml_bigint() vector exact decimal text; "double" nearest double; "error" raises zutoml_unrepresentable. datetimes "convert" (default) returns POSIXct Date; "keep" returns date-times text. local_time "character" (default) returns local time text; "difftime" seconds since midnight. max_size largest document accepted, bytes, Inf. max_depth deepest nesting tables arrays, counting ; 1023. max_items keys plus array elements, Inf. max_string longest string key, decoded bytes, Inf.

title: Parse a TOML document — toml_parse
text: named list, one element per top-level key.

title: Parse a TOML document — toml_parse
text: array becomes vector elements strings, booleans, numbers, dates, date-times one kind. Numbers widen: integers floats give double vector. Booleans never join numbers. empty array logical(0). one-element array becomes vector marked (), writing back gives array . Anything else list. simplify = "none" makes every array list. datetimes = "keep", date-times returned RFC 3339 text instead ("1979-05-27T07:32:00Z", zero offset written Z, fraction 0, 3, 6 9 digits). Fractions past nanoseconds truncated, TOML requires; POSIXct holds microseconds. Valid TOML R hold raises zutoml_unrepresentable: string key containing U+0000, float beyond range double, integer beyond 2^53 big_integers = "error".

title: Parse a TOML document — toml_parse
code: doc <- ' title = "TOML Example" ports = [8000, 8001, 8002]  [owner] name = "Tom Preston-Werner" dob = 1979-05-27T07:32:00-08:00  [[products]] name = "Hammer" sku = 738594937  [[products]] name = "Nail" sku = 284758393 color = "gray" ' x <- toml_parse(doc) x$owner$dob #> [1] "1979-05-27 15:32:00 UTC" x$ports #> [1] 8000 8001 8002  toml_parse(doc, data_frame = TRUE)$products #>     name       sku color #> 1 Hammer 738594937  <NA> #> 2   Nail 284758393  gray

title: Check that a document is valid TOML — toml_validate
text: Runs whole check phase toml_parse() (lexer, grammar, rules defining tables keys, every value, limits) without building R value. exactly check toml_parse() makes, limits: two disagree document valid TOML R hold, string containing U+0000.

title: Check that a document is valid TOML — toml_validate
code: toml_validate(   x,   version = c("1.1.0", "1.0.0"),   max_size = 64 * 1024^2,   max_depth = 128L,   max_items = 1e+06,   max_string = 2^31 - 1,   error = FALSE )

title: Check that a document is valid TOML — toml_validate
text: x TOML document: single string, raw vector UTF-8 bytes. version TOML version read: "1.1.0" (default) "1.0.0", refuses forms 1.1.0 added (\e \xHH escapes, times without seconds, newlines trailing comma inline tables). max_size largest document accepted, bytes, Inf. max_depth deepest nesting tables arrays, counting ; 1023. max_items keys plus array elements, Inf. max_string longest string key, decoded bytes, Inf. error FALSE (default), return FALSE document valid. TRUE, raise condition instead, caller learns .

title: Check that a document is valid TOML — toml_validate
text: TRUE x valid TOML within limits. Otherwise FALSE, error = TRUE condition class zutoml_parse_error zutoml_limit_error (see zutoml-conditions) carrying line, column, byte offset kind fault.

title: Check that a document is valid TOML — toml_validate
code:
toml_validate('title = "TOML"
[owner]
name = "Tom"
') #> [1] TRUE toml_validate("a = 1
a = 2
") #> [1] FALSE  # Why not, and where: tryCatch(   toml_validate("a = 1
a = 2
", error = TRUE),   zutoml_parse_error = function(e) c(e$kind, e$line, e$column) ) #> [1] "duplicate_key" "2"             "1"

title: Conditions raised by zutoml — zutoml-conditions
text: Every error zutoml raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zutoml_error.

title: Conditions raised by zutoml — zutoml-conditions
text: zutoml_invalid_argument argument unusable, value written TOML given, list partial names string valid UTF-8. Carries arg, argument fault. zutoml_parse_error document TOML. Carries line column (1-based, characters), offset (0-based, bytes) kind, name rule broken, "bad_escape" "table_redefined". zutoml_unrepresentable document valid TOML holds value R : string containing U+0000, string longer R string, integer beyond 2^53 big_integers = "error". zutoml_unsupported_type R value TOML form, function, raw vector matrix. Carries path, key path value, .b[3].c. zutoml_na_error NA NULL value na = "error". Carries path. zutoml_limit_error limit reached. subclasses zutoml_size_limit, zutoml_depth_limit, zutoml_item_limit zutoml_string_limit name one. Carries limit, argument's name, "max_depth", limit_value. zutoml_io_error file connection read written.

title: Conditions raised by zutoml — zutoml-conditions
code: tryCatch(   stop(structure(     class = c("zutoml_parse_error", "zutoml_error", "error", "condition"),     list(message = "TOML parse error", call = NULL)   )),   zutoml_error = function(e) class(e)[1] ) #> [1] "zutoml_parse_error"

what: zutoml: Read and Write 'TOML' Documents — zutoml-package
title: zutoml: Read and Write 'TOML' Documents — zutoml-package
text: Parses 'TOML' (Tom's Obvious Minimal Language) version 1.0 documents ordinary R values writes R values 'TOML'. Every 'TOML' type maps one R type, including four date time types, strings never reinterpreted. Invalid documents refused line column fault, configurable size, depth item limits. Output deterministic readable. Conformance checked 'toml-test' suite (https://github.com/toml-lang/toml-test) directions. parser writer written C system library required.

text: toml_parse() reads TOML document ordinary R values: tables named lists document order, arrays vectors elements share type, date-times POSIXct Date, integers beyond 2^53 toml_bigint(). data_frame = TRUE turns arrays tables data frames. toml_validate() checks document valid TOML, within size, depth, item string limits, error = TRUE says (line, column, offset kind classed condition). pass every case toml-test suite TOML 1.0.0 1.1.0. TOML 1.1.0 read default; version = "1.0.0" reads strictly.
